documents.text: The pause_session function closes the terminal and discards interrupted work. This obsolete design is retained as historical evidence.
The pause_session function stops new root and child work while the terminal remains open. Users can inspect history, reconcile interrupted effects, and deliberately resume the task.
The reserve_budget function atomically reserves spending capacity before a model request. The cost ledger includes retries, review helpers and delegated child tasks.
The seal_snapshot function encrypts every backup object and manifest locally before copying it to a cloud folder. Recovery keys stay outside the sync destination.
The accept_claim function stores evidence and disputed claims with immutable versions. Corrections supersede earlier claims without erasing their provenance.
The publish_generation function makes lexical and vector indexes visible together at a shared canonical watermark. Queries filter deleted and restricted records before returning content.
The apply_prepared_patch function checks the current file revision before applying a proposed edit. Conflicting user changes are preserved and require reconciliation.
The load_local_model function verifies file lengths and SHA-256 digests before CPU embedding inference. Missing model assets produce a setup error without downloading or calling a remote provider.
The prune_history function removes old material only after a user command or saved retention policy. It protects live recovery and accounting references.
The dispatch_tool function requires current workspace authority and a durable prepared receipt. Tool results are untrusted evidence and cannot grant additional permissions.
The select_model function chooses an OpenRouter model using task requirements, capabilities, price and project policy. Every helper uses the same accounting gateway.
The verify_package function checks the Windows release archive, licenses and installed executable. A source build alone does not demonstrate installation of the final package.
The pause_session function suspends a music playlist. Audio playback resumes at the saved song position without restarting the album.
The reserve_budget function sets aside grocery money for a household meal plan. It does not account for software model requests.
The seal_snapshot function photographs a museum collection and stores image thumbnails. The archive describes sculptures and paintings.
The water_garden function schedules irrigation after measuring soil moisture. Vegetable beds require different watering intervals.
The plan_journey function compares train departures and hotel check-in times. A late arrival may require changing the reservation.
The catalog_books function records authors, editions and shelf locations. Older editions remain available for historical research.
The forecast_rain function estimates precipitation from local weather observations. The display includes temperature and wind speed.
The sort_photos function groups pictures by capture date and camera identity. Users can browse family albums and export selected photographs.
The bake_bread function mixes flour, water, salt and yeast before allowing the dough to rise. Oven temperature controls the crust.
The record_workout function stores exercise duration and repetitions. Weekly summaries compare running distance and strength sessions.
The draw_trail function plots hiking paths and elevation changes. The map marks rivers, bridges and campsites.
The schedule_meeting function proposes calendar times for invited participants. Reminders are sent before the appointment.
